WITH hand_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(p.throws, 'MISSING') AS throws,
    COUNT(*) AS tally
  FROM manager_award ma
  INNER JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY COALESCE(p.throws, 'MISSING')
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT SUM(tally) AS total 
  FROM hand_counts
),
hand_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    throws,
    tally,
    CAST(tally AS NUMERIC) / (SELECT total FROM total_count) AS share
  FROM hand_counts
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share 
  FROM hand_shares
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT 
    throws,
    tally,
    share
  FROM hand_shares
  WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM average_share)
),
above_avg_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(tally) AS combined_tally,
    AVG(share) AS avg_share_above,
    AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM average_share)) AS above_avg_amount
  FROM above_average
)
SELECT 
  combined_tally,
  avg_share_above,
  above_avg_amount
FROM above_avg_stats;
